name: Zutto Aishite Soba ni Ite
original_name: ずっとあいしてそばにいて
source:
Sometimes, I dream of unpleasant things that happened in the past.
Besides that, there's nothing that would disrupt my peaceful life.
...or so I thought before I met him. Before I started suspecting him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15545]Freem![/url]]
translation:
有时，我会梦见过去发生的不快之事。
除此之外，没有什么会打乱我平静的生活。
……在遇见他之前，在开始怀疑他之前，我是这么以为的。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15545]Freem![/url]]
